questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He made the cake all by _____.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The pronoun "**himself**" is used as a reflexive pronoun to indicate that the subject (**He**) performed the action on his own.
 
• Options like "**yourself**" or "**myself**" are inappropriate as they do not match the subject (**He**).
 
• The word "**herself**" is also incorrect, as the subject refers to a male individual (**He**).
 
• Thus, the correct reflexive pronoun to complete the sentence is "**himself**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He made the cake all by himself."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (yourself):** This is incorrect as the sentence refers to "He," not "You."
 
• **Option 3 (myself):** This is incorrect as the speaker is not referring to themselves, but rather to "He."
 
• **Option 4 (herself):** This is incorrect as "He" refers to a male subject, not a female subject.
 
• **Option 5:** This option is not applicable in this context.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

(A) The friends excited planned their upcoming vacation, / (B) researching destinations / (C) and creating an itinerary filled with / (D) thrilling activities and adventures.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence lies in **part A**, which states: "The friends excited planned their upcoming vacation."
 
• The word "**excited**" is incorrectly used as an adverb in this context. The correct form should be "**excitedly**" to describe how the friends planned their vacation.
 
• Adverbs are used to modify verbs, and in this case, "**excitedly**" is the appropriate adverbial form to modify the verb "planned."
 
• Thus, the corrected phrase should be: "**The friends excitedly planned their upcoming vacation."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **A**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The friends excitedly planned their upcoming vacation, researching destinations and creating an itinerary filled with thrilling activities and adventures."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **B: "researching destinations"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **C: "and creating an itinerary filled with"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "thrilling activities and adventures."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.

questions.question: In the sentence 'The strategist’s thoughts were very coherent', what is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'coherent'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Incomprehensible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"coherent"** means logical and consistent; ideas that are clear and well-organized. (सुसंगत)
 
 
• **Example:** Her speech was coherent, making it easy for everyone to understand her point of view.
 
 
• **"Incomprehensible"** refers to something that cannot be understood or is unclear. It is the antonym of coherent. (असमझने योग्य)
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were incomprehensible, leaving the participants confused.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'coherent' **is **'incomprehensible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Incomprehensible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Systematic** (व्यवस्थित): Something done according to a fixed plan or system; methodical.
 
 
• **Example:** Her systematic approach to studying helped her achieve top grades.
 
 

 
• **Logical** (तार्किक): Something based on clear, sound reasoning.
 
 
• **Example:** His argument was logical and convincing.
 
 

 
• **Lacklustre** (निस्तेज): Something lacking in vitality, force, or enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** The movie received poor reviews due to its lacklustre plot.
 
 

**Question:** In the sentence 'The strategist's thoughts were very coherent', what is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word 'coherent'?

**The correct answer is:** **Incomprehensible**.
